# Agentic AI & Modern System Design Pathway

> The complete open-source pathway for AI-assisted engineering, autonomous agents, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, GSD framework, and modern distributed system architecture. Zero prerequisites, hands-on projects, free forever.

## Core Learning Pathway

- [Pathway Overview](https://github.com/SriSatyaLokesh/System-Design/blob/main/Agentic%20AI/README.md): Complete curriculum guide taking engineers from AI tool beginners to AI-native builders in 4–5 hours.
- [01 - AI Ecosystem](https://github.com/SriSatyaLokesh/System-Design/blob/main/Agentic%20AI/01-ecosystem/README.md): Distinguish AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT), autonomous agents, and AI copilots; includes platform comparison and chat vs. repository AI decision matrices.
- [02 - Tools & Prompt Engineering](https://github.com/SriSatyaLokesh/System-Design/blob/main/Agentic%20AI/02-tools/README.md): Hands-on adoption guide for Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor with prompt anti-patterns and context-engineering exercises.
- [03 - GSD Framework](https://github.com/SriSatyaLokesh/System-Design/blob/main/Agentic%20AI/03-gsd/README.md): Structured Goal → Spec → Deliver workflow to decompose complex software tasks and eliminate AI hallucinations.
- [04 - Autonomous AI Agents](https://github.com/SriSatyaLokesh/System-Design/blob/main/Agentic%20AI/04-agents/README.md): Multi-agent orchestration, delegation patterns, AutoGPT, LangChain, and CrewAI frameworks.
- [05 - AI Skills & Model Context Protocol](https://github.com/SriSatyaLokesh/System-Design/blob/main/Agentic%20AI/05-skills/README.md): MCP standard, skill packaging, Anthropic tools, and runtime capability extension.
- [06 - Capstone Portfolio Project](https://github.com/SriSatyaLokesh/System-Design/blob/main/Agentic%20AI/06-capstone/README.md): Build and deploy a production portfolio site with AI assistance using 13 real-world prompts and prefilled PRD templates.

## System Architecture Foundations

- [AI Engineering](https://github.com/SriSatyaLokesh/System-Design/blob/main/AI/README.md): Foundation model lifecycle, RAG architectures, evaluation frameworks, and production guardrails.
- [System Design Bibles](https://github.com/SriSatyaLokesh/System-Design/blob/main/System%20Design%20bibles/README.md): Scalability principles, data-intensive architecture (DDIA), and Clean Architecture fundamentals.
- [Distributed Caching](https://github.com/SriSatyaLokesh/System-Design/blob/main/Caching/README.md): Redis caching patterns, cache-aside, write-through, TTL strategies, and high-throughput cache topologies.
- [Notification Systems](https://github.com/SriSatyaLokesh/System-Design/blob/main/Notification%20Systems/notes.md): Real-time distributed notification engines, fanout queues, idempotency, rate limiting, and delivery retries.
- [Node.js Enterprise Architecture](https://github.com/SriSatyaLokesh/System-Design/blob/main/Node%20JS/README.md): Event-driven microservices, high-throughput I/O, concurrency patterns, and backend performance tuning.

## Optional

- [Free AI Certifications](https://github.com/SriSatyaLokesh/System-Design/blob/main/Agentic%20AI/free-certifications/README.md): Free industry certifications and interactive courses from Anthropic and DeepLearning.AI.
- [Prompt Engineering Handbook](https://github.com/SriSatyaLokesh/System-Design/blob/main/Prompt-Engineering/prompt-engineering-beginner-to-pro-guide.md): Structured prompting frameworks, system instructions, few-shot patterns, and chain-of-thought elicitation.
- [GitHub Repository Metadata & SEO Guide](https://github.com/SriSatyaLokesh/System-Design/blob/main/docs/seo/github-repository-metadata.md): Configuration settings, topic tags, and Open Graph banner guidelines for repository maintainers.
- [Full Aggregated Knowledge Base](https://github.com/SriSatyaLokesh/System-Design/blob/main/llms-full.txt): Complete standalone text digest for deep reasoning and single-context AI ingestion.
